result.title: All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking
result.comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Project Page: https://yellowon0103.github.io/all-st3r-slam/
result.summary: SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a core technology in autonomous systems that enables them to estimate their own position and build a map of unknown environments simultaneously. SLAM systems in dynamic environments are of great practical importance. However, existing dynamic SLAM approaches still have several limitations like over-removal and high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM framework that precisely removes moving objects at the pixel level without relying on predefined labels or segmentation models. Our system combines pixel motion predicted by ego-motion using DUSt3R with point tracking from All-Tracker, removing only actually moving pixels by analyzing discrepancies between the two motion sources. Unlike object-level masking methods, our approach eliminates only currently moving regions, allowing temporarily static parts to be utilized for tracking. Operating at approximately 10 FPS, the system achieves real-time performance on standard 30 FPS video streams by subsampling every 3 frames. Relying solely on RGB inputs, this significantly improves upon state-of-the-art dense dynamic SLAM approaches (0.5-3 FPS), presenting a highly practical solution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 All-St3R SLAM：用 DUSt3R 的 ego-motion 预测与 All-Tracker 点跟踪的差异，在像素级只剔除真正运动的区域，仅凭 RGB 在约 10 FPS 下实现动态环境实时 SLAM。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「双路运动来源差异」可作为视觉证据可靠性与动态筛选的类比线索：可能启发 LVR 中按当前有效性而非固定标签选择视觉 token 或证据，供核查，但不涉及 latent 推理状态。
